title: Fun evening!
text: We had a terrific experience during this tour. Our guide, Alan, was great! He explained everything - not just the food, but the tradition behind it. We had some really interesting conversation with him too. He is a very knowledgeable guy! Thank you!
author: Mary Ann D

title: A wonderful evening with a great host and great food!
text: An amazing way to meet a local and enjoy truly great local food.  We went to two terrific places and had more than enough food and drink.  Very enjoyable…don’t hesitate to book this tour.  Alan was a wonderful guide.
author: Wendy_N

title: Best of Barcelona
text: My wife Tawnya and I had the absolute pleasure of having Krisztina as our guide during our walking tour of Barcelona, and we couldn't be more impressed. She was not only incredibly knowledgeable about the city's rich history and cultural landmarks but also had a gift for storytelling that made everything come alive. Her English was perfect, making the tour easy to follow, and she was always happy to answer any questions we had. What really stood out, though, was her warm and personable nature. Krisztina made us feel so welcome and made the experience both educational and fun. We highly recomme
author: Navigator310096

title: Wonderful night
text:
Great host 
Good pick for our likes and dislikes
Pick of bites and wine were very good.
Our guide was a very nice and knowledgeable.
author: Cindy_G

title: Great sights, excellent food!
text:
We had a wonderful visit with Lusi who gave us a great tour of Barcelona. We went to some great local spots, saw some great sights, had some amazing dishes, and she was super fun and interesting throughout the tour!

Thank you!
author: Julian_R

title: Great custom evening tapas tour!
text: Our traveling party of 8 people had a private custom tapas evening tour with Ruxandra.  This is the second time that we have had a tour with her and this one was just as good if not better than the first one.  She is an excellent guide who is very passionate, informative and kind.  She was able to change the tour around a little for the benefit of our elderly parents.  The places that she took us for food were outstanding and the history in between stops was even better.  Thank you Ruxandra and we hope to see you again on our trip visit to Barcelona!
author: mitchc944

title: Excellent Tour Host
text: We had a great time with our tour guide and learned a lot about Spain and Catalunya. I would highly recommend this tour for people with curious minds and open hearts.
author: csturm56mecom

title: Great tapas, vermouth, and interesting conversation.
text: RK was a very good host. He took the time to explain many things about the differences in vermouth and introduced us to a variety of tapas. He is also a great listener and ensured we safely caught a cab back to our hotel. This is a fun way to learn more about Barcelona.
author: Sherri_B

title: Tapas and wine tour
text: Had a wonderful time with Sebastian. He showed us the bars the locals love as well as some great recommendations. Felt like we had a friend showing us around. Highly recommend.
author: Amy_H

title: Alessandro was the perfect guide!
text: Our evening felt just like being out with a friend.  We enjoyed 3 stops at places with different specialties and different atmospheres.  We loved them all and could have easily spent more time talking with Alessandro!
author: Julie V
